measures: one-byte-or-one-UTF-8-scalar oracle inside the standalone harness
grammar-derived eight-byte scalar classifier inside the same harness
method.statistics: 40 paired samples per row with paired bootstrap simultaneous 95% intervals after the predeclared Bonferroni correction
method.replay_rule: profile.raw.json and PROFILE-REPORT.md are the authoritative historical measurement; a fresh execution is a new run and must not overwrite or be represented as reproducing the frozen samples

rejection_reasons: the always-on classifier rejects the standalone prototype for production promotion
whitespace/punctuation rows and compact 1 KiB violate their predeclared calibrated regression guards
long-scalar improvements cannot cancel regressions in other admitted families under the predeclared decision rule
the prototype is an isolated dependency-free Rust correctness and measurement control, not parse-that, a BBNF-emitted parser, the totality backend, or a hybrid Rust/ASM emitter
the measurement does not establish cross-machine reproducibility, end-to-end generated-parser superiority, or superiority over the broader named SOTA cohort
a successful correctness gate cannot override the performance rejection

correctness_gate.meaning: the harness and frozen classification contracts are internally coherent; this is not promotion

allowed_use: retain as a negative performance witness
use decisive regressions to prioritize scalar-path profiling and code-generation work
compare future materially different emitters under a newly sealed measurement epoch

limitations: The frozen report belongs to its recorded measured commit and dirty digest, which precede the final frozen carrier commit.
This receipt preserves reported intervals; it does not recalculate them from raw timing samples.
The classifier remains REJECT even if a later machine happens to produce faster unsealed measurements.
